headline: Samsung 990 SSD costs 50% more than 990 Pro, but is slower
summary: Samsung's new 990 SSD costs $270 for 1TB and $530 for 2TB, with slower performance than 2022's 990 Pro model.
details: Samsung has introduced a new, non-Pro model of its 990 series solid state drives, the 990 SSD. It costs $270 for a 1TB size and $530 for 2TB.
The 990 SSD promises sequential read and write speeds maxing out at 7,250 MB/s and 6,450 MB/s, while random read and write speeds cap out at 850K and 1,200K input/output operations per second.

In comparison, the original 990 Pro SSD from 2022 had sequential read and write speeds of up to 7,450 MB/s and 6,900 MB/s and random read and write speeds of up to 1,400K and 1,550K input/output operations per second.
The price increase is significant, with the 990 Pro SSD now costing $320 for 1TB and $640 for 2TB, more than doubling its initial price.

headline: Nintendo Switch 2 bundle with game is $50 off at $449.99
summary: The Nintendo Switch 2 console bundle with a digital game is now $449.99, effectively giving you a game for free.
details: The Nintendo Switch 2 console bundle, which normally costs $499.99, is now available for $449.99 at Amazon. This discounted price effectively gives you a free game, as the bundle usually saves you $20 or $30 depending on the game chosen.
The bundle includes a digital game, with options such as Mario Kart World, Donkey Kong Bananza, or Pokémon Pokopia. This offer is a rare discount on the Nintendo Switch 2.
The price of the Nintendo Switch 2 console will increase to $499.99 in September. Additionally, it's unclear if the console will continue to include a discounted game with purchase at that point.
